randomSelection.eligibilityRule: Before every draw filter by allowedItemCategories, allowedEquipmentSlots, allowedWeaponTypes and minimumEquipmentRank when present; exclude stat keys already selected on this item and normalize remaining weights. Block is shields-only; shields share all other normal weapon affixes. Movement speed is boots-only from rank 4. Random affixes only; gem sockets separate.
randomSelection.uniquenessScope: Per individual item across all random affix slots; armor and weapons. Same stat may appear on separate items. Attributes and their derived stats are distinct affixes.
randomSelection.drawRule: Before each draw, filter by item eligibility and remove stat keys already selected on this item; normalize remaining eligible weights. Every available slot receives exactly one distinct stat. Slot count must not exceed eligible distinct stats.

futureSmithingDesign.status: Future design direction only; not implemented
futureSmithingDesign.scope: Targeted improvement of individual rolled affix values
futureSmithingDesign.normalImprovement: Use appropriate materials with a success chance to raise an existing value toward its normal rank maximum.
futureSmithingDesign.masterwork: After reaching the normal maximum, rarer special materials may allow additional masterwork improvements; six main attributes could reach 10 instead of the R6 drop maximum 8 as an example.

weaponValueScaling.application: Apply once to full-reference values. Shields have the same pool as normal weapons plus exclusive Block. Block is not available on armor or other weapons.

physicalCalibration.rounding: Ceil physical set totals to ensure effective level never falls below target; tolerate 1e-9 floating point noise
physicalCalibration.rule: Override final physical set totals after historical scaling; each class calibrated independently. R2 through R6 calibrated; R1 independently reduced by the approved whole-point starter adjustment.

r1StarterAdjustment.rule: Subtract only the whole-number magnitude of the previously calculated negative level-1 armor target from existing R1 armor; magnitudes below 1 unchanged. This does not calibrate effective armor level to 1.

magicalCalibration.level1: Unarmored class baseline only; no R1 gear included
magicalCalibration.rounding: Ceil aggregate magical defense target, tolerate 1e-9 floating point noise, then distribute whole points across five slots
